first_regular_grid: first anchor+3k days at or after completed planting; never backfill missed preplant management
missed_grid: observe immediately once, record lateness; next strictly future original grid, no catchup irrigation for multiple missed slots
zone_merging: merge all adjacent eligible probe zones into maximal contiguous ridge ranges; ascending first ridge; each range one call
cross_local_date: always refresh before any remaining range; refreshed decisions restricted to previously selected but unattempted ridges for this grid
settlement_recheck: confirmation only; cannot initiate a new irrigation decision
daily_maturity_switch: first public overview showing at least1 MATURE ridge; latch true, thereafter next local08:00 daily; matured ridges never receive irrigation
commit_daily_physics: not used; advances24h, never treated as refresh
pending_lock: operation type+overlapping ridge set+unreconciled dispatch, independent of dispatch ID; partial/unknown locks remain
stale_observation: ETA arrival/lock release never validates old observation; irrigation requires current grid decision and fresh observation
sensor_noise: same initial seed, actual call order saved; extra settlement reads may consume different RNG draws; never reset RNG
same_environment_scope: within each pair only; design fingerprint != development ID != realized initial hash
original_protocol_deviation: Original v2 08:00 not followed; retained. This explicit protocol registers actual development timing, not retroactive compliance.
